answer: A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit. The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the ledge of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Every claim climbs the glacier of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the crystal re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
